summary: GWAS select completed: selected 2 reusable study/studies: exposure Hexadecanedioate levels (GWAS Catalog study_id=GCST90243839, ancestry=european, n=6,887); outcome Coronary artery disease (GWAS Catalog study_id=GCST90132314, ancestry=european, n=1,165,690). Selection reason: Exposure: the requested trait is 'hexadecanedioate levels'. The closest eligible candidates are GCST90243839 ('Hexadecanedioate levels', reported_trait_matches_request true, 6887 European, executable) and met-a-711 ('Hexadecanedioate', reported_trait_matches_request false, 6887 European, executable). GCST90243839 preserves the full requested wording and endpoint definition, so it is preferred over the shortened met-a-711 label despite met-a-711 having extra unit metadata. GCST90199807 ('Hexadecanedioate (C16-DC) levels') is also a direct metabolite-level endpoint but its label is a parenthetical variant rather than the exact full requested trait, so GCST90243839 remains the closest full-label match. Other candidates are unrelated fatty acids or disease-restricted metabolite levels and are excluded. Outcome: the requested trait is 'coronary artery disease'. Eligible candidates with reported_trait_matches_request true include GCST90132314 (European, 1165690), GCST90132315 (multi_ancestry, 1378170), GCST90837195 (European, 457512), GCST90081466 (European, 283203), and others. No explicit ancestry constraint was imposed. GCST90132314 is a direct 'Coronary artery disease' endpoint with documented European ancestry and a large sample, and is preferred over the multi_ancestry GCST90132315 because the exposure is European and GCST90132314 avoids mixed-ancestry comparability concerns while retaining the exact requested label. GCST005195 and GCST005194 have unknown ancestry and are excluded under the ancestry-resolution rule. FinnGen and UKB 'Major coronary heart disease event' candidates are related but not the exact requested CAD endpoint and are not preferred over direct CAD labels.
